description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Imports and Exports Control Act, No. 01 of 1969
categorisation: This gazette contains the promulgation of new regulations (Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 07 of 2025) under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, No. 1 of 1969. It involves legal/regulatory matters including amendments to existing regulations, extension of validity periods, and authorization for issuing operational instructions to relevant authorities. While a minister is named, this is primarily a regulatory gazette focused on trade control legislation rather than government personnel or structural changes.
